name: Strange Chronicles of Tang: The Nine-tiered Labyrinth
overview: County magistrate Su Wuming is drawn into a deadly series of kidnappings linked to a decades-old murder case. Trapped in a sinister underground replica of the “Nine-Tier Tower” alongside the original judge, he must unravel twisted testimonies, confront a pair of cunning twins, and navigate a string of murders to uncover the truth—facing life-or-death choices at every turn.
